findings.title: Client filesystem directory aliases bypassed protected-name filtering
findings.reproduction: Synthetic materials/exports/original.md denied directly; materials/copies symlink to exports allowed both read and overwrite through copies/original.md. No real export was accessed.
findings.root_cause: Only lexical components and final leaf symlink were checked; canonical parent was checked solely for containment.
findings.resolution: Integrator added per-parent lstat symlink rejection and canonical protected-name validation. Concurrent hostile filesystem mutation is not proven race-free by this test.

findings.title: Built-in strict profile did not establish protected runtime-file boundary
findings.reproduction: Sibling materials and Studio data directories in OS temp passed validation; custom profile was rejected in favor of literal strict. Agent does not enforce client callback confinement on its native tools.
findings.qualification: Official current documentation says built-in sandbox may fall back when unavailable; strict permits temp and selected home paths. Actual installed-version canary tests are owned by root; this reviewer did not launch a real paid Grok session.
findings.resolution: Integrator now requires a custom profile. Correct profile content, actual host paths, fail-closed startup and native denial still require runtime evidence; profile name alone is not proof.

findings.title: Delegated file writes could succeed with empty durable tool evidence
findings.reproduction: A fake agent issued fs/write_text_file without any session tool notification then returned valid JSON/end_turn. Real client callback changed synthetic file while stored job said external_effects=[], outcome_unknown=false. Partial-write fault also erased uncertainty.
findings.resolution: Client emits unique novel-engine:client-write UUID in_progress/completed evidence independently. Failed writes emit unknown because truncate or partial data may already have occurred. Callbacks refuse to begin after abort; late completion leaves captured uncertainty. No original file content enters evidence.

findings.title: One-hundred-tool evidence cap erased uncertainty for omitted tools
findings.reproduction: Fake ACP sent 100 completed tool events then a 101st in_progress tool, valid JSON, end_turn. Stored evidence retained 100 and recomputed outcome_unknown=false.
findings.recommended_resolution: Bound event growth by stopping safely or preserve explicit sticky truncation/unknown evidence; do not recompute certainty solely from a truncated list.
findings.resolution: The 101st distinct tool marks uncertainty and throws a provider error before success, aborting the turn. API regression preserves a failed job with 100 retained effects, outcome_unknown=true, and no prompt replay.

findings.title: Equal JS length with unequal UTF-8 byte length throws in CSRF comparison
findings.reproduction: principalGuard with synthetic authenticated principal, CSRF cookie a and header é throws ERR_CRYPTO_TIMING_SAFE_EQUAL_LENGTH instead of expected rejection.
findings.qualification: Not an authentication bypass or proof of process DoS. Initial reproduction was against the same baseline source; this pass reread the unchanged function.
findings.recommended_resolution: Compare encoded byte lengths before timingSafeEqual; add API rejection and session-still-valid regression.

findings.title: Concurrent editor autosave deletes a captured Review source before persistence
findings.reproduction: Real temporary SQLite and real ReviewService/DocumentService/ReviewStorePart. Save R2 using autosave, start delayed provider review which captures R2, save R3 then R4 with autosave=true inside 30 seconds, release provider. Captured prompt and evaluation still hold R2 and original prose, but recordCompletedReviewJob throws ReviewSourceInvalidatedError because autosave collapse deleted R2. Identical ordinary-save control completes successfully.
findings.qualification: Controlled service/store reproduction on current TypeScript source, not stale dist, real provider, browser, or HTTP request. Existing source-invalidated handling converts missing source into a controlled failure but does not preserve the ongoing review when the author keeps typing.
findings.recommended_resolution: Preserve captured revisions across provider wait and successful persistence, without creating misleading completed review/snapshot records on failure. Add autosave-collapse regression alongside ordinary-edit and deleted-source checks.

resolution.detail: One app-owned refcounted RevisionRetentionPins instance is shared by document and review stores. Synchronous capture protects autosave collapse and retention pruning through provider wait and atomic outcome persistence. Finally paths release on failure and completion; successful snapshot references take over retention. Idempotent per-evaluation leases preserve concurrent reviews.

review_lease_observations: Capture and acquire execute synchronously before provider yield. API/CLI persistence composition shares a single pin owner per app instance.

Successful evaluation transfers lease to caller; provider/invalid-output failures release in finally, completed and retry outcome stores release after transaction, application callers also idempotently release.
No provisional durable snapshots before success. Transaction failure rolls back snapshot/job/event changes while releasing pins.
Concurrent reviews release independently; after last release normal autosave collapse and retention pruning resume. Deleted source remains controlled failed job.
Pins are app-instance memory, not cross-process SQLite locks. No claim of coordination between independent servers writing the same database.
